name: Octree-based memory virtualization
aliases: Crassin et al. Octree-based memory virtualization
definition: An out-of-core rendering approach for multi-channel volume data sets where octree nodes and bricks store information on up to n channels.
summary: Octree-based memory virtualization is an out-of-core rendering technique that maps data files to virtual memory, relying on the OS to handle page faults instead of explicit cache management.
